text:
Son Yeon-jae Celebrates christmas with Family, Husband’s Financial Firm Revealed
Former South Korean rhythmic gymnast Son Yeon-jae shared a glimpse into her holiday celebrations and recent life updates, including details about her family and her husband’s prominent role at a Los Angeles-based hedge fund. The Olympic medalist posted photos on instagram on December 24th, offering fans a peek into her Christmas at home with her son, Jun-yeon.
A Christmas at Home
Son Yeon-jae’s Instagram post, accompanied by the message “Christmas at my house🎄🧑🎄🎅♥️,” showcased a festive atmosphere. Photos revealed a beautifully decorated Christmas tree, which reportedly fit easily into the home thanks to its high ceilings. The images offer a rare look into the personal life of the celebrated athlete,now focused on motherhood and new ventures.
From Rhythmic Gymnastics to Family Life
Son Yeon-jae retired from competitive gymnastics and married a financial industry professional in 2022, nine years her senior. She gave birth to her son, Jun-yeon, in February of last year. The couple made headlines in November 2023 with the purchase of a single-family home in Itaewon, Seoul, for 7.2 billion won – approximately $5.5 million USD.
Building a Future Beyond the Mat
Following her retirement,son Yeon-jae has dedicated herself to nurturing the next generation of gymnasts,establishing a rhythmic gymnastics academy. She has also recently launched a YouTube channel to connect with fans and share her experiences.
Husband Leads Ulysses Capital
Further details revealed that Son Yeon-jae’s husband serves as the CEO of Ulysses Capital, a family office and global hedge fund based in Los Angeles. The firm specializes in managing family funds and, as of the first quarter of 2021, reportedly managed over 2 trillion won (approximately $1.5 billion USD) in assets using 100% proprietary accounts.A company release indicated that Ulysses Capital focuses on direct investment and advisory services for ultra-high-net-worth families.
Son yeon-jae’s transition from a world-class athlete to a mother, entrepreneur, and wife continues to captivate the public, offering a compelling narrative of success and fulfillment beyond the competitive arena.
